parameters.description: Optional: 16 to 64 letters, digits, - or _. A retry with the same key and body replays the first answer for 24 hours; the same key with another body is 422.

400.description: Refused by the store's rules, with the reason (nothing_to_change, not_ready, not_empty, no_subscribers, invalid_arguments, invalid_request).

401.description: No token or an unknown one (unauthorized); token_expired, token_revoked, or token_inactive (its creator is no longer the store owner).

409.description: changed (with a fresh preview), conflict (with current), already_exists, confirmation_invalid, open_bot_chat_first, or idempotency_in_progress.

429.description: rate_limited or daily_cap; wait for Retry-After seconds.

503.description: busy: another change holds what this one needs; telegram_unavailable: Telegram did not take the message. Retry after Retry-After seconds.

post.description: Reply to a support ticket as the store: the reply is stored on the ticket, then the bot sends it to the buyer (delivered says whether Telegram took it). 1 to 4,000 characters, refused rather than cut. A reply with a link, @mention, email or phone number needs the owner's approval. The same reply again within 10 minutes answers the first instead of sending twice.

parameters.description: Optional: 16 to 64 letters, digits, - or _. A retry with the same key and body replays the first answer for 24 hours; the same key with another body is 422.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
